create_shiny_dataset: create a ShinyDataset instance from a config to load shiny dataset images and camera poses
read_meta_shiny: read metadata including poses, bounds, intrinsics, and ray directions from a shiny dataset directory
prepare_render_data_spiral: prepare spiral render poses for the ShinyDataset using focus depth and camera radii
convert_rays_to_ndc: convert ray origins and directions to NDC space using focal length and near plane
create_dense_shiny_dataset: create a DenseShinyDataset instance that loads grid-arranged images with row and column skip sampling
